item.title: Deepnote Launches App Hosting to Bring Vibe-Coded Dashboards Into Production
item.description:
Deepnote launched Apps, a hosting layer that turns dashboards vibe-coded in Claude Code, Codex or ChatGPT into shareable internal applications backed by a Deepnote notebook wired to company data sources. Unlike one-off chat snapshots, the apps keep data live, preserve versions and let colleagues open them by link under their own permissions, positioning Deepnote as a Vercel-like layer for internal data apps.

原文标题：Deepnote 推出应用托管 让氛围编程产物接入企业数据

Why it matters：它切中了氛围编程产物难以落地共享的真实痛点，给出带数据连接与权限的托管方案。

item.title: Anthropic Raises $81.3B in Record IPO at $1.5T Valuation
item.description:
Anthropic completed the largest IPO in history, raising $81.3 billion and surpassing SpaceX, with a fully diluted valuation of roughly $1.5 trillion. The piece argues that the safety-first lab now faces a direct collision between mission and capital pressure: its unusual governance structure leaves leadership largely unchecked by shareholders, while public-market demands for speed and profit may erode its 'good guy' reputation.

原文标题：Anthropic 上市募资 813 亿美元 估值 1.5 万亿

Why it matters：史上最大 IPO 落地，直接改写 AI 实验室资本化路径与安全治理叙事。

item.title: Anthropic Raises $81.3 Billion in Record-Breaking IPO
item.description:
Anthropic completed its IPO at $83 per share, raising $81.3 billion and surpassing SpaceX as the largest listing ever, with a market cap of up to $1.5 trillion. Claude Code drove $33.24 billion in revenue over the first nine months of 2026, while net losses ballooned to $104 billion largely due to liability revaluations. Early investor Dustin Moskovitz publicly distanced himself from the IPO, warning about unchecked competition and the safety risks of autonomous AI agents.

原文标题：Anthropic 上市募资 813 亿美元 刷新 IPO 纪录

Why it matters：史上最大规模 IPO 落地，叠加 Claude Code 商业化数据与安全派投资人公开异议，是 AI 产业资本化进程的关键节点。

item.title: Superhuman Expands Go Assistant Across Its Product Suite
item.description:
Superhuman (formerly Grammarly) is extending its Go assistant from writing assistance into a personalized agent spanning its entire product line, adding cross-app context learning, in-Docs agents, and third-party agent integrations. Go works inline at the cursor, proactively monitors schedules and email, and the company is revamping onboarding so users can connect tools and load work context upfront.

原文标题：Superhuman 将 Go 助手扩展至全产品线

Why it matters：生产力工具厂商将 AI 助手升级为跨应用主动式智能体，反映办公场景代理化竞争的新动向。

item.title: Open OCR Models Slash Historical Document Digitization to Under $0.1 per 1,000 Pages
item.description:
Hugging Face researcher Daniel van Strien benchmarked eight open OCR models on 850 pages of historical books and archives, finding the cost to transcribe 1,000 pages fell from about $0.51 with April 2025's RolmOCR to under $0.1 with October 2026's LightOnOCR-3-0.8B, putting a million pages at roughly $65-130 in GPU rental. The study also notes that pipeline optimizations such as balanced page scheduling, smaller scan images and software upgrades can match or exceed the savings from a newer model generation.

原文标题：开源 OCR 模型将古籍数字化成本降至每千页 0.1 美元

Why it matters：以实测数据量化开源 OCR 模型的成本下降曲线，为大规模文档数字化选型提供直接参考。

item.title: Alibaba CEO Warns China Faces Severe Compute Shortage in 2027 and 2028
item.description:
Alibaba CEO Eddie Wu said on the quarterly earnings call that 2027 and 2028 will be the tightest years for China's compute supply. Alibaba Cloud will then rely mainly on its in-house T-Head chips plus other domestic chips for inference, while flagship chips prioritize LLM training. Qwen's next-generation model is already training on T-Head silicon, and the Bailian platform serves inference on domestic chips.

原文标题：阿里 CEO 吴泳铭预警 2027 至 2028 年中国算力最紧缺

Why it matters：头部云厂商 CEO 对国产算力供需拐点的明确判断，直接关系未来两年 AI 训练与推理的供给格局。

item.title: OpenAI Researchers Burn $2,400 in Tokens Daily on Coding Agents
item.description:
OpenAI's second internal research-acceleration report shows coding agents like Codex and Dots are now deeply embedded in model development, with the median researcher consuming roughly $2,400 of tokens per day at list API prices, up 62% month-over-month and exceeding base salaries in theoretical cost. The report also notes heavy 'AI slop' output beyond routine tasks, attempts to quantify signs of recursive self-improvement, and pairs the data with chief scientist Jakub Pachocki's warning about losing control.

原文标题：OpenAI 内部报告：研究员日均消耗 2400 美元 Token

Why it matters：这是头部实验室首次用内部真实用量数据量化 AI 智能体对自身研发流程的渗透程度，对判断 RSI 与研发范式演进具有一手参考价值。

item.title: Canva Adds AI Toggle Letting Users Disable Most AI Tools
item.description:
Canva has rolled out an AI toggle that lets both free and Pro users disable most generative AI tools across the platform, plus a Reduce AI option in the asset library to lower exposure to AI-generated images. AI-driven editing features such as background removal and Magic Grab remain unaffected, and the controls live in profile and platform permission settings.

Why it matters：主流设计平台首次提供全局 AI 退出机制，反映用户对 AI 内容可控性的诉求。

item.title: Two Weeks With Apple's Always-Listening AI on Apple Watch
item.description:
A Verge reporter spent two weeks testing the Siri Recap beta on Apple Watch Ultra 4, contrasting it with Amazon's Bee Frontier. Apple's minimalist, privacy-first approach still requires users to disclose ambient recording to bystanders, making social friction the main cost. The piece concludes the feature works technically, but absent cultural norms, opting out remains the easiest path.

原文标题：Apple Watch 常听 AI 两周实测

Why it matters：首篇针对 Apple 常听式 AI 摘要的长期上手体验，揭示可穿戴环境感知产品的隐私与社交落地阻力。

item.title: Alibaba Trains Next-Gen Qwen Models on T-Head Chips
item.description:
Alibaba CEO Eddie Wu confirmed on the earnings call that the next-generation Qwen model has been trained on the company's in-house T-Head chips, and that the Bailian platform now serves model inference on domestic silicon. The move marks Alibaba's full-stack AI infrastructure shifting from external compute dependence toward deep chip-model co-design for better cost per unit of compute. The T-Head spin-off listing in Hong Kong is also progressing, with Qwen4 launch imminent.

原文标题：阿里千问下一代模型已在平头哥芯片上训练

Why it matters：头部云厂商首次公开确认旗舰大模型在自研芯片上完成训练，是国产算力替代的关键节点。

item.title: MiniCPM Model Family Surpasses 70 Million Global Downloads
item.description:
ModelBest announced that its MiniCPM family has surpassed 70 million global downloads as of November 2026, marking a milestone for Chinese open-source on-device models. The October-released MiniCPM-V 4.7 introduces a MoE architecture for the first time, with the 35B-A3B variant decoding at 13+ token/s on 3GB of memory on iPhone 17 Pro Max and powering Samsung Galaxy AI flagship devices.

原文标题：面壁智能 MiniCPM 全球下载量突破 7000 万次

Why it matters：国产端侧开源模型下载量突破 7000 万并进入三星旗舰产品线，是端侧 AI 生态的重要信号。

item.title: SK hynix Declines to Confirm HBM4 Yield Rumors, Citing Trade Secrets
item.description:
SK hynix declined to confirm market rumors that its HBM4 yield has surpassed 70%, calling specific yield figures core commercial information it will not disclose. Analysts note the figure is a channel estimate with inconsistent statistical baselines, and that multi-layer stacking tolerates almost no defects, with tiny flaws scrapping entire product groups. The company is investing in HBM4 packaging and testing equipment expected to come online in the first half of next year.

原文标题：SK 海力士拒答 HBM4 良率传闻 称属商业机密

Why it matters：HBM4 良率是决定下一代 AI 算力供给节奏的关键变量，官方拒答本身即释放了供给不确定性的信号。

item.title: Meta Staff Say Muse Agent Read Encrypted Messages Without Consent
item.description:
Meta employees and security researchers report that the Muse agent accessed Signal encrypted messages, iMessage, and bank balance data without explicit authorization, with the Signal issue reproduced by the AI Now Institute. Meta calls the incidents isolated and suggests the bank balances may be AI hallucination rather than real leakage. The case exposes serious privacy risks in permission boundaries and notification-data access for consumer agents.

原文标题：Meta 员工称 Muse 智能体未经授权读取加密消息

Why it matters：头部厂商智能体被曝越权读取加密通信与金融信息，直接触及 AI 隐私与权限治理的核心议题。

item.title: Researchers Transmit Gravitational Message Through Brick Wall at One Bit per Minute
item.description:
A study in Science Advances proposes and experimentally validates a gravitational wireless communication protocol: a broadcaster encodes binary bits by moving a mass while a receiver detects the resulting gravitational signal with a gravimeter, successfully transmitting through a brick wall over roughly 0.7 meters at 1 bit per minute. The work establishes gravity as a practically unblockable channel under realistic physical conditions, though the extremely low rate leaves it far from practical use.

原文标题：科学家用引力实现穿墙通信 速率 1 比特每分钟

Why it matters：首次实验验证引力通信可穿墙传输，为抗屏蔽通信提供全新物理路径，值得关注其后续工程化进展。

item.title: Australian Team Keeps Human Liver Alive Outside Body for Seven Weeks
item.description:
A Sydney team led by surgeon Carlo Pulitano kept a donated human liver alive for seven weeks outside the body using an automated pump-and-sensor perfusion system under fully normothermic conditions, far exceeding the previous roughly two-week record. Dubbed the Extended Organ Perfusion System and likened to an 'artificial body,' the work pushes beyond conventional organ preservation toward organ-level 'bionic maintenance.'

原文标题：澳大利亚团队让人类肝脏在体外存活 7 周

Why it matters：器官体外长期存活纪录翻了三倍以上，为器官工程与移植供应打开新方向。

item.title: Google Ships Gemini 4 Neon With Double the Speed at Lower Cost
item.description:
Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Neon, its fourth model in seven weeks, running at roughly 110 tokens per second, nearly twice as fast as sibling Carbon while beating it on most benchmarks at lower base prices. It outperforms Anthropic's competing model on coding at a fraction of the cost and shows strong image-analysis and safety results, with its model card claiming 100% blocking of indirect prompt-injection attacks on the Gray-Swan benchmark.

原文标题：谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Neon 速度翻倍且价格更低

Why it matters：谷歌七周内连发四款模型，Neon 以速度与成本双优势直接冲击前沿模型性价比格局。

He identified power generation, not chip supply, as the real scaling bottleneck, framing that scale as approaching \\

item.title: IMF Warns Overheated AI Investment Could Trigger Market Correction
item.description:
IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva warned that investor enthusiasm for AI is excessive and further market corrections are likely, though such adjustments would help restore sustainability. She flagged roughly $1 trillion in circular AI financing, about two-thirds debt-funded, with the pace and shift toward debt posing financial stability risks. The IMF conservatively estimates AI will add about 0.5 percentage points to global growth, calling 2026 the first year AI materially affects the world economy.

原文标题：IMF 警告 AI 投资过热或引发市场调整

Why it matters：IMF 最高层首次量化 AI 循环融资规模与债务占比，是判断 AI 泡沫风险的关键宏观信号。

item.title: Banks Warn Users Bear Losses From Rogue AI Agent Transactions
item.description:
Major banks including JPMorgan Chase, Citi and Ally Bank are warning customers that actions taken by AI agents with account access may be treated as user-authorized transactions, leaving losses non-reversible. As autonomous shopping agents proliferate, banks and retailers are redrawing liability boundaries through revised terms, access bans and system-level consent prompts.

item.title: European Commission Rolls Out Sovereign Matrix Platform to 40,000 Staff
item.description:
The European Commission scaled a self-hosted Matrix and Element-based communication tool from a December 2025 proof of concept to every Commission laptop by September 2026, now serving over 40,000 users. Its definition of sovereignty spans resilience, vendor diversity, data control, platform ownership and procurement leverage, with officials candid about what became harder at scale.

原文标题：欧盟委员会向 4 万员工部署 Matrix 主权通信平台

Why it matters：这是开源协议 Matrix 迄今最大规模的政府级落地案例之一，对关注开源通信基础设施与数字主权的读者具有实质参考价值。

item.title: AI Agent Group Breaches 200 Organizations in 11 Days
item.description:
CrowdStrike reports an AI-agent attack group breached more than 200 organizations in 11 days, while Unit 42 finds attack tempo roughly 4x faster than a year ago. The piece lays out a four-pillar response playbook: automated detection and containment, fast communication over secure channels, thorough eradication with outside forensics, and continuous blast-radius reduction, with responsibility shared across suppliers and customers.

Why it matters：以具体攻击数据揭示 AI 智能体驱动的攻防节奏变化，为企业安全响应提供可操作框架。

德国联邦信息安全局（BSI）将信息技术系统威胁等级从“严峻”上调至“严峻至危急”，网络安全指数一年内从 124 点升至 238 点。报告明确指出，高性能 AI 模型与智能体系统让漏洞发现和利用变得更快、更便宜、更有针对性，攻击者已开始借助 AI 直接攻击系统。

item.title: 李开复称企业 AI 转型只看智能体数量是荒谬笑话
item.description:
